fidelity: The source (arXiv:2007.07362 Section 5 = DCG Section 6) uses I_2 from line 1229 onwards for the linear operator I_2(u) = u + u* + sum M(u_(1)*, u_(2)) of Theorem 5.7 / DCG Theorem 32, with the mixing operator of Definition 5.6 / DCG Definition 31. The printed base case M_{2,1,2}(u,v) = u b v is a misprint of Ehrenborg-Readdy Definition 9.1 (v b u): only the ER reading makes the source's eq. (5.1), Theorem 32, Corollary 33 and the symmetry M(u,v) = M(v,u) true. Root scores the record under the ER reading; the conjecture fails at n = 5 with an explicit symmetric certificate, and at degree <= 5 the formula agrees with the poset-defined transform on a spanning set, so the failure concerns Hetyei's poset construction itself. The printed-reading failure from n = 2 is a misprint artefact and earns nothing. The printed codomain Q<a,b>_{n+1} is a slip; I_2 preserves degree.
significance: qualified: a mechanical 32x32 rank computation the author did not run, but a genuine refutation of a stated structural conjecture in a refereed paper, with a growing excess (1, 2, 7 at n = 5, 6, 7); matches small-exact-counterexample precedents (350721). 347231 fails through the source's own false Lemma 36 and is recorded as a remark in the 347230 paper.
